tall white-framed window with a white radiator beneath it; on the RIGHT the corner of a

chest height, absolutely no tilt, no angle, no perspective skew — a flat front-on
framing like a mirror photo. They stand side by side, close together, shoulders square
to the camera, both facing the lens.

nothing but wardrobe door and the top of the window, and their shoes sit close to the
bottom edge. Full body head to shoes, nothing cropped. Bright natural daylight coming
in through the window from the left, sharp, slight grain, authentic social-media photo.
No text, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no graphics.
